fns.desc: gas_server_rx_initial_req: if handler->req_cb() sets *comeback_delay<0, function returns 0 without freeing or storing 'resp' -- verified safe only because the single real caller (dpp_supplicant.c) always pairs comeback_delay=-1 with resp==NULL; a future/other req_cb implementation violating that undocumented convention would leak the wpabuf. Not a confirmed live bug today (contract-dependent), flagging as a fragile API contract worth a comment/assert.
